name: specsket
description: Analyze project briefs, research specifiable products, and stage evidence-backed project, product, or supplier records for review.

interface.shortDescription: Project intelligence and product sourcing workflows
interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta to analyze project briefs and requirements, dynamically profile and normalize product families, or run product discovery and supplier onboarding. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection for live project context, schemas, taxonomy, deterministic validation, staged review records, and signed-in review links. The plugin cannot publish or approve records.
defaultPrompt: Find a fast shortlist of products for my project
Analyze these project briefs into rooms and layered requirements
Deeply assess these selected products for specification readiness
Normalize and stage these product or supplier records
